color.note: Dark is the default for console and stage; light is the printable case report; stage is tuned for a washed-out 1920×1080 projector. Every text pair is checked at 4.5:1 in all three themes.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: App ground behind every panel. Dark: deep Atlantic ink. Light: limestone. Stage: a deeper ink so a washed projector still separates panels.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels: the panorama, reasoning and map columns; the run bar.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Cards inside panels: evidence cards, candidate rows, question card, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, input wells, key caps, the bearing ruler band.

tokens.name: line-1
tokens.usage: Hairlines: graticules, dividers, card edges. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Control boundaries (inputs, toggles, outline buttons) and chart axes. 3:1 or more against surface-1 and surface-2 in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-1
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-0 to surface-3. Also neutral evidence and the default pin/ring stroke.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, inactive tabs, on surface-0 to surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: captions, units, axis labels, queued/skipped stages, not_visible answers. Holds 4.5:1 on surface-0 to surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels only (exempt from contrast). Never for information that matters.

tokens.name: model
tokens.usage: Model actor: anything a local model observed (OCR, detector, VLM, embeddings). Chips, observation brackets, reference-photo points, heatmap family. As text on surface-1 to surface-3 and on model-soft.

tokens.name: model-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind model chips and model-attributed rows.

tokens.name: on-model
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid model fill.

tokens.name: solver
tokens.usage: Solver actor: what our fusion code decided. Estimate bars, candidate pins, the final surveyor's mark, expected-score readouts. As text on surface-1 to surface-3 and on solver-soft.

tokens.name: solver-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind solver chips and the selected candidate row.

tokens.name: on-solver
tokens.usage: Text on a solid solver fill (pin rank numerals, primary solver button).

tokens.name: team
tokens.usage: Team actor: what a human did (answered, sent a cue, submitted). Chips and the answer receipt. Never used for Skip. As text on surface-1 to surface-3 and on team-soft.

tokens.name: team-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind team chips and answer receipts.

tokens.name: on-team
tokens.usage: Text on a solid team fill.

tokens.name: cost
tokens.usage: Spending: every point multiplier (×0.95, ×0.8, ×0.5) and the time budget past 80%. Always shown with a × figure or a clock. As text on surface-1 to surface-3 and on cost-soft.

tokens.name: cost-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind cost tags and the over-budget timer.

tokens.name: on-cost
tokens.usage: Text on a solid cost fill (the over-budget pill).

tokens.name: support
tokens.usage: Evidence supports a candidate. Always with the ▲ / + glyph. As text on surface-1 to surface-3 and on support-soft.

tokens.name: support-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind supporting cells in the evidence × candidate matrix.

tokens.name: contra
tokens.usage: Evidence contradicts a candidate; a stage failed or timed out; the VLM returned invalid JSON. Always with the ▼ / × / clock glyph. As text on surface-1 to surface-3 and on contra-soft.

tokens.name: contra-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind contradicting cells and failure rows.

tokens.name: on-contra
tokens.usage: Text on a solid contra fill (the RULED OUT stamp).

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Evidence that neither supports nor contradicts (the ● glyph). Alias of ink-3.

tokens.name: opt-a
tokens.usage: Option A identity: the A key on question cards and the A zone outline and hatch on the map. Identity only, never meaning; always with the letter A and its hatch. As text on surface-1 to surface-3.

tokens.name: opt-a-soft
tokens.usage: Option A row tint on the question card when hovered or chosen.

tokens.name: on-opt-a
tokens.usage: Letter on a solid option A key.

tokens.name: opt-b
tokens.usage: Option B identity: the B key on question cards and the B zone outline and hatch on the map. Identity only, never meaning; always with the letter B and its hatch. As text on surface-1 to surface-3.

tokens.name: opt-b-soft
tokens.usage: Option B row tint on the question card when hovered or chosen.

tokens.name: on-opt-b
tokens.usage: Letter on a solid option B key.

tokens.name: opt-c
tokens.usage: Option C identity: the C key on question cards and the C zone outline and hatch on the map. Identity only, never meaning; always with the letter C and its hatch. As text on surface-1 to surface-3.

tokens.name: opt-c-soft
tokens.usage: Option C row tint on the question card when hovered or chosen.

tokens.name: on-opt-c
tokens.usage: Letter on a solid option C key.

tokens.name: opt-d
tokens.usage: Option D identity: the D key on question cards and the D zone outline and hatch on the map. Identity only, never meaning; always with the letter D and its hatch. As text on surface-1 to surface-3.

tokens.name: opt-d-soft
tokens.usage: Option D row tint on the question card when hovered or chosen.

tokens.name: on-opt-d
tokens.usage: Letter on a solid option D key.

tokens.name: conf-high
tokens.usage: Confidence high: three filled cells. Alias of ink-1.

tokens.name: conf-med
tokens.usage: Confidence medium: two filled cells. Alias of ink-2.

tokens.name: conf-low
tokens.usage: Confidence low: one filled cell. Alias of ink-3.

tokens.name: conf-unknown
tokens.usage: Confidence unknown: three dashed empty cells and the word "unknown". Never drawn as low.

tokens.name: status-queued
tokens.usage: Stage queued: hollow circle.

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: Stage running: filled circle with a live elapsed clock against the stage deadline. No spinner.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Stage done: check mark.

tokens.name: status-skipped
tokens.usage: Stage skipped (optional stage dropped or not needed): dashed circle with a hop arrow.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Stage failed: cross, plus the fallback that ran.

tokens.name: status-timeout
tokens.usage: Stage timed out: clock glyph, plus the fallback that ran.

tokens.name: seg-sky
tokens.usage: Scene class "Sky": the segmentation tint on the panorama and its segment in the visible-share bar. Always labelled; the bar keeps a 2px gap between segments and this order: sky, building, grass, tree, road, water, ground, masked.

tokens.name: seg-building
tokens.usage: Scene class "Building": the segmentation tint on the panorama and its segment in the visible-share bar. Always labelled; the bar keeps a 2px gap between segments and this order: sky, building, grass, tree, road, water, ground, masked.

tokens.name: seg-grass
tokens.usage: Scene class "Grass and field": the segmentation tint on the panorama and its segment in the visible-share bar. Always labelled; the bar keeps a 2px gap between segments and this order: sky, building, grass, tree, road, water, ground, masked.

tokens.name: seg-tree
tokens.usage: Scene class "Tree": the segmentation tint on the panorama and its segment in the visible-share bar. Always labelled; the bar keeps a 2px gap between segments and this order: sky, building, grass, tree, road, water, ground, masked.

tokens.name: seg-road
tokens.usage: Scene class "Road and pavement": the segmentation tint on the panorama and its segment in the visible-share bar. Always labelled; the bar keeps a 2px gap between segments and this order: sky, building, grass, tree, road, water, ground, masked.

tokens.name: seg-water
tokens.usage: Scene class "Water": the segmentation tint on the panorama and its segment in the visible-share bar. Always labelled; the bar keeps a 2px gap between segments and this order: sky, building, grass, tree, road, water, ground, masked.

tokens.name: seg-ground
tokens.usage: Scene class "Bare ground and soil": the segmentation tint on the panorama and its segment in the visible-share bar. Always labelled; the bar keeps a 2px gap between segments and this order: sky, building, grass, tree, road, water, ground, masked.

tokens.name: seg-masked
tokens.usage: Scene class "Masked (photographer)": the segmentation tint on the panorama and its segment in the visible-share bar. Always labelled; the bar keeps a 2px gap between segments and this order: sky, building, grass, tree, road, water, ground, masked.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Heat step 0: fully transparent, the low end. The map shows through.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Heat step 1 of 5 (pixel-geolocation density, light to dark in light theme, dark to bright on dark). One hue only.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Heat step 2 of 5 (pixel-geolocation density, light to dark in light theme, dark to bright on dark). One hue only.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Heat step 3 of 5 (pixel-geolocation density, light to dark in light theme, dark to bright on dark). One hue only.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Heat step 4 of 5 (pixel-geolocation density, light to dark in light theme, dark to bright on dark). One hue only.

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Heat step 5 of 5 (pixel-geolocation density, light to dark in light theme, dark to bright on dark). One hue only.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Sea and large rivers on the map base. Desaturated so data reads first.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Land inside PT, ES and FR.

tokens.name: map-land-out
tokens.usage: Land outside the three countries in scope (Morocco, Italy…). Recedes.

tokens.name: map-border
tokens.usage: District and province borders (hairline).

tokens.name: map-border-country
tokens.usage: National borders and coastline stroke.

tokens.name: map-graticule
tokens.usage: Graticule lines every 1° (or 0.01° in town view).

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: Place labels on the map base.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset by a 2px surface gap. 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: The linked selection: an evidence card, its pixels and its map area outlined together, with a leader line.

tokens.name: photo-halo
tokens.usage: Halo behind any label drawn on the panorama photo.

tokens.name: on-photo
tokens.usage: Labels on top of the panorama (with photo-halo).

tokens.name: mask-hatch
tokens.usage: The photographer-mask hatch over the bottom of the panorama.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs.

groups.name: Console
groups.note: Operator density at 1440×900 and 2560×1600. Sentence case everywhere.

styles.name: console-title
styles.usage: Panel titles: Panorama, Reasoning, Map, Candidates.

styles.name: console-heading
styles.usage: Card headings, question text, candidate names.

styles.name: console-body
styles.sample: Granite masonry, wrought-iron balconies, a river in view.
styles.usage: Default text in the console.

styles.name: console-label
styles.usage: Chips, field labels, tab labels, legend entries.

styles.name: console-micro
styles.usage: Chart captions and footnotes. Never for anything the operator must act on.

groups.name: Console data
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono: every figure the same width, 0 and O distinct. For coordinates, scores, times, estimates and verbatim OCR text.

styles.name: console-data
styles.usage: Coordinates, estimates, durations, OCR readings in rows and cards.

styles.name: console-data-sm
styles.usage: Bearing-ruler numerals, matrix cells, axis ticks.

styles.name: console-readout
styles.usage: Run-bar readouts: multiplier, timers, expected score.

groups.name: Stage
groups.note: Projector density at 1920×1080. Nothing smaller than 20px; body 24px reads from the back row.

styles.name: stage-title
styles.usage: The one focus on a stage frame: question text, panel title.

styles.name: stage-body
styles.sample: A postcode in a format only Portugal uses.
styles.usage: Default text on stage.

styles.name: stage-label
styles.usage: Chips, legends and labels on stage.

styles.name: stage-caption
styles.sample: Reading signs: a postcode in a format only Portugal uses
styles.usage: The caption bar sentence.

styles.name: stage-data
styles.usage: Coordinates and estimates on stage.

styles.name: stage-readout
styles.usage: Multiplier, timer and replay speed on stage.

styles.name: stage-score
styles.usage: The expected-score count-up on the final stage frame. Once per frame.

groups.name: Narrative
groups.note: Newsreader is the case file's own voice: stage headlines, the report, and inference lines. It never carries a number.

styles.name: narrative-display
styles.usage: Stage opening card and the case-report cover. Once per screen.

styles.name: narrative-headline
styles.usage: Stage beat headline above the caption.

styles.name: narrative-title
styles.usage: Case-report section titles; screen titles on intake and final answer.

styles.name: inference
styles.sample: a Portuguese postcode for central Porto
styles.usage: The inference line on an evidence card (console). Italic serif = a reasoned step, not a reading.

styles.name: stage-inference
styles.sample: a Portuguese postcode for central Porto
styles.usage: The inference line on stage.

groups.name: Verdict
groups.note: The only capitals in the system. At most one stamp in view.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: RULED OUT, CONFIRMED BY MATCH, SUBMITTED stamps in the console.

styles.name: stage-stamp
styles.usage: Stamps on stage.

spacing.note: 4px base. Console uses space-2 to space-4 inside components; stage doubles the step (space-4 to space-8).

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Gap between a mark and its 2px surface ring; between stacked bar segments.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; chip padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and key caps; console row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Console card padding; gap between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Console panel padding; stage chip padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between console sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Stage card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Stage panel padding; console page margins at 2560 wide.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Stage frame margins.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Stage opening card margins.

radius.note: Instrument-square. Corners say what kind of thing it is: 0 for imagery and maps, 2px for chips and keys, 4px for controls and cards, 8px only for sealed case cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panorama strip, map, crops, matrix cells — anything that is a picture of the world.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Chips, key caps, evidence brackets, estimate bars' data end.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, evidence cards, candidate rows, question card.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Sealed case cards in the queue, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles and the replay-speed badge only.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows, separate things at rest. Shadows only for what floats above the case.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Tooltips, popovers, the zoom-crop card.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px surface gap, then 2px of solid focus colour. Box-shadow so it follows the radius.

border.note: Line weights. Stage doubles every hairline so it survives a projector.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Console hairlines, card edges, graticules.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Console emphasis: selected card, known uncertainty ring, leader lines; every stage hairline.

tokens.name: border-heavy
tokens.usage: Stage emphasis: selected card, stamps, final ring.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Panels.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Panorama overlay layers and map data layers.

tokens.name: z-leader
tokens.usage: Leader lines between evidence, pixels and map.

tokens.name: z-runbar
tokens.usage: The run bar (sticky).

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Tooltips, zoom crops, menus.

tokens.name: z-caption
tokens.usage: Stage caption bar.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

duration.note: Motion tokens (defined now, built later). Every animation corresponds to a real log event. Reduced motion: cross-fade at dur-quick, nothing moves.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback (≤100 ms).

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Small state changes: chip appears, toggle, status icon swap, reduced-motion cross-fade.

tokens.name: dur-standard
tokens.usage: Cards and panels entering or leaving; question card open.

tokens.name: dur-deliberate
tokens.usage: Estimate bars resizing, uncertainty rings contracting, multiplier ticking down.

tokens.name: dur-cinematic
tokens.usage: Map flights at one zoom step; scale 1000–2000 ms by zoom levels crossed.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between list items (30–60 ms).

tokens.name: dur-stagger-cap
tokens.usage: Total stagger never exceeds this; long lists cut to the cap.

easing.note: Ease-out to enter, ease-in to leave, one gentle spring for the final pin.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Entrances: cards, boxes, evidence lifting into the feed.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Exits: rejected boxes fading, ruled-out candidates ghosting.

tokens.name: ease-move
tokens.usage: In-place change: bars, rings, map flights, ruler turning to north.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: The final surveyor's mark landing. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost
tokens.usage: Ruled-out candidates and SAM-rejected boxes (with strike-through; never opacity alone).

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: Layers not in focus when one evidence item is selected.

tokens.name: opacity-zone
tokens.usage: Option zone fill under its hatch on the map.

size.note: Fixed sizes that layouts depend on.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Console compact controls: layer toggles, key caps.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Console buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: size-control-stage
tokens.usage: Stage buttons and option rows (minimum).

tokens.name: size-runbar
tokens.usage: Run bar height in the console.

tokens.name: size-ruler
tokens.usage: Bearing ruler height under the panorama (console).

tokens.name: size-caption
tokens.usage: Stage caption bar height.

tokens.name: size-mark
tokens.usage: Final surveyor's mark diameter (console); stage doubles it.
